_doc: PRODUCER EVIDENCE per canonical ask type. A type is `proven` only when a REAL path was observed emitting it, with the run and case cited. Enforced by tests/test_protected_types_have_proven_producers.py.
_rule: NEVER TREAT 'GUARD PASSES' AS EVIDENCE UNLESS THE PROTECTED STATE IS PROVEN REACHABLE. A mapping can be correct while its protected input never occurs -- which is how a consumption question came to be labelled menu_size while the negative-invariant test passed.

menu_size.note: ⚠ PROVEN BUT CONTAMINATED — case 2 rep2 is a consumption question wearing this label. Producer exists; it is not CLEAN.

continuous_portion.note: ⚠ case 3 rep1 is a portion_multiplier question wearing this label.

consumption_complete.note: ⛔ ZERO producers. Observed being emitted AS menu_size (case 2). The one type with no defensible default is the one that collapses into a defaultable one.

portion_multiplier.note: ⛔ ZERO producers. The Panda probe called the typing helper with an EMPTY ambiguities list; case 3 emits continuous_portion instead.
